seo_description: Privacy information for MEVCO International website inquiries.
p_01: How information submitted through this website is handled.
p_02: When you submit a message through the contact form, MEVCO intends to use the information solely to assess and respond to your inquiry and manage potential business relationships.
p_03: The form requests your name, company, business email, country, area of interest and message. The hosting provider may collect standard technical information needed to operate and protect the website.
p_04: If deployed to Netlify, submissions are processed through Netlify Forms. Additional privacy terms and storage locations will depend on the final hosting configuration.
p_05: Before publishing, add the company's legal identity, privacy contact address, jurisdiction-specific retention terms, and any other disclosures required by applicable law. This notice is a launch draft and should be reviewed by legal counsel.
